name: Koshiba Anna
source:
"It's the privilege of being a neighbor."

[url=/c124651]Hinata[/url]'s childhood friend and former neighbor. They became separated after Anna had to move away. Without realizing Hina's true identity, she and him are seated next to each other in the class, becoming neighbors again.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/character_anna.html]official website[/url]]
